title: Meta Tags and SEO Basics
description: Understand the role of meta tags in HTML and learn basic SEO techniques.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the `<meta charset="UTF-8">` tag?
quiz.explanation: This meta tag declares the character encoding used for the document.

quiz.question: Which meta tag is used to control viewport settings on mobile devices?
quiz.explanation: It helps control layout and scaling on different devices.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the `<meta name="description" content="...">` tag?
options: Provides a brief summary for search engines
Specifies the author of the page
quiz.correctAnswer: Provides a brief summary for search engines
quiz.explanation: The description meta tag helps search engines understand page content.

quiz.question: Which meta tag instructs search engines whether to index or follow links on a page?
quiz.explanation: It controls crawling and indexing behavior of search engines.

quiz.question: Why is the `<title>` tag important for SEO?
options: It appears as the clickable headline in search results
quiz.correctAnswer: It appears as the clickable headline in search results
quiz.explanation: The title tag is crucial because it directly influences search rankings and user clicks.

quiz.question: Which meta tag is deprecated and generally not recommended to use for SEO?
quiz.explanation: Most modern search engines ignore the keywords meta tag due to misuse and spam.

quiz.question: What does 'SEO' stand for?
quiz.explanation: SEO involves techniques to improve website visibility in search engine results.

quiz.question: Which attribute of the `<meta http-equiv>` tag can be used to refresh the page after a certain time?
quiz.explanation: It tells the browser to reload the page after a set time interval.

quiz.question: How can you improve SEO using meta tags?
options: By adding relevant descriptions and keywords
By increasing the page load time
By using more images without alt text
quiz.correctAnswer: By adding relevant descriptions and keywords
quiz.explanation: Relevant meta descriptions help search engines understand the page, improving ranking.

quiz.question: Which of the following is NOT a good SEO practice?
options: Using keyword stuffing in meta tags
quiz.correctAnswer: Using keyword stuffing in meta tags
quiz.explanation: Keyword stuffing can lead to penalties and lower rankings.
